records.original_stem:
Case A: A package contains 21 prednisone 5-mg tablets and no other substance subject to the relevant prescription-drug special-packaging provision.

Case B: A second otherwise comparable package contains 22 prednisone 5-mg tablets; staff consider only the 5-mg tablet strength when evaluating the exception.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The second package totals 110 mg and does not meet that 105-mg threshold.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 22×5=110mg이며 개별 tablet strength만 보아서는 안 된다.

B.original_option_text: The absence of other substances covered by the provision is part of the stated exception.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 총량 외 조성 조건도 유지한다.

C.original_option_text: Exceeding this product threshold automatically proves that no other lawful packaging exception can exist.
C.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. Product exemption과 환자·prescriber 요청 경로는 구분한다.
교정된 설명: Failure to meet this product exception is separate from evaluating a lawful patient-request pathway.

D.original_option_text: The first package totals 105 mg and meets the stated package-total threshold for that prednisone exception.
D.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 21×5=105mg이다. 해당 조문은 tablet 수가 아니라 package total과 다른 조건을 본다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: Staff extend the sublingual nitroglycerin packaging exception to every nitrate formulation, including products outside the stated exception.

Case B: A potassium supplement is in unit-dose form, and the reviewer compares its per-unit amount to the stated 50-mEq threshold rather than treating all potassium packages alike.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Any isosorbide dinitrate formulation at any strength meets the named exception.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Sublingual/chewable·10mg 이하라는 조건을 유지한다.
교정된 설명: The isosorbide dinitrate exception identifies sublingual or chewable forms at the stated strength limit.

B.original_option_text: Moving any mnemonic-packaged product into another container preserves the same exception without review.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Manufacturer packaging 조건이 있는 예외는 실제 포장을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Manufacturer mnemonic-package exceptions do not automatically survive arbitrary pharmacy repackaging.

C.original_option_text: The potassium exception ignores dosage form and applies to any amount in a bulk bottle.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Unit-dose와 unit당 50mEq 이하 조건을 함께 본다.
교정된 설명: The potassium exception uses its specified unit-dose form and per-unit potassium limit.

D.original_option_text: The sublingual nitroglycerin exception does not exempt every nitrate formulation.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 성분·제형별 예외를 약리계열 전체로 확대하지 않는다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A patient requests a reusable dose planner, and the pharmacy proposes filling it with medication previously dispensed by a different pharmacy under the pharmacy-packaging pathway.

Case B: The patient's old closure still clicks shut, and staff take that as proof that child-resistant performance and product stability are preserved.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A closure that clicks shut necessarily meets both child-resistance and stability requirements.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 마모·재사용 제한·제품별 포장 성능을 별도로 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Closing mechanically does not prove required child-resistant performance or product stability.

B.original_option_text: A non-CR request removes all other container-protection requirements.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. CR waiver와 chemical stability 보호는 다른 문제이다.
교정된 설명: A non-child-resistant request does not waive light, moisture, or other stability protection.

C.original_option_text: The described pharmacy dose-planner pathway does not permit using medication previously dispensed by a different pharmacy.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 해당 pharmacy packaging 경로와 home-care 정리 서비스 등을 구별한다.

D.original_option_text: The planner's maximum supply period guarantees stability for every included medicine.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 실제 약물·container compatibility와 더 짧은 한도를 유지한다.
교정된 설명: A planner's stated supply maximum cannot override a shorter product stability limit.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy proposes putting an as-needed medicine into fixed-time multidrug single-dose cells alongside scheduled maintenance medicines.

Case B: A 60-day pack is planned even though one included medicine's applicable stability expires sooner, and staff also propose mixing commercial liquids in one container without a compounding authorization.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Correct medication names alone satisfy every compatibility and container condition.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 포장 내 약물·재료 적합성·용량·식별 조건을 함께 본다.
교정된 설명: Compatibility, container capacity, identification, and tamper-evidence conditions remain applicable.

B.original_option_text: The described multidrug single-dose pathway excludes the proposed PRN placement.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. PRN과 scheduled maintenance의 포장 조건을 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: A 60-day packaging maximum overrides every shorter prescription supply limit.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Packaging과 prescribed quantity·schedule-specific limit는 다르다.
교정된 설명: The maximum 60-day packaging supply is not a new prescription-supply authorization.

D.original_option_text: A 60-day pack ceiling authorizes longer stability and any mixing of commercial liquids.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 포장 최대치·제품 안정성·compounding authorization을 따로 확인한다.
교정된 설명: The pack cannot ignore the shorter stability limit or treat unauthorized liquid mixing as mere packaging.

records.original_stem:
Case A: For a federal retail-limit exercise, a customer has already purchased 2.4 g of the regulated base chemical today and seeks another package containing 1.5 g of that base.

Case B: The clerk calculates the limit using total tablet weight instead of the regulated base amount.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The proposed same-day total is 3.9 g and exceeds the stated 3.6-g retail daily limit.
A.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 2.4+1.5=3.9g이다. 거래 하나가 아니라 적용 daily total을 본다.

B.original_option_text: Every distribution channel has one identical 30-day limit.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Retail9g과 해당 mail/mobile7.5g 등의 별도 조건을 구별한다.
교정된 설명: The retail and specified mail or mobile-vendor limits must be distinguished.

C.original_option_text: Total tablet mass including inactive ingredients is the stated legal measure.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Base equivalent와 salt/tablet mass를 구별한다.
교정된 설명: The limit uses the regulated base chemical rather than total tablet mass.

D.original_option_text: A new calendar month automatically resets every purchase in the preceding 30 days.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 30-day window와 calendar month는 다르다.
교정된 설명: The described 30-day individual retail limit uses a rolling 30-day interval rather than simply a calendar month.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A seller leaves regulated pseudoephedrine product openly accessible to customers without the described behind-counter or locked-storage process.

Case B: A single sales package qualifies for the specified 60-mg-or-less logbook exception, and staff apply it as an exemption from every quantity and sale requirement.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A qualifying small-package logbook exception removes all quantity and sale restrictions.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 특정 기록 예외를 포괄적 판매 면제로 확대하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The narrow logbook exception does not erase every other applicable sales condition.

B.original_option_text: Required logbook entries may be discarded immediately after the customer's next purchase.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 각 entry의 최소 보존 의무를 유지한다.
교정된 설명: Required logbook entries are retained for at least the specified two years.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacy license alone replaces the separate regulated-seller training and certification framework.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 기관·인력 면허와 CMEA seller 요건을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: Seller self-certification and employee training are distinct from professional pharmacy licensure.

D.original_option_text: The described controlled-access storage and staff-provision requirements still apply to the sale pathway.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Behind counter 또는 locked cabinet과 직원의 제공 절차를 확인한다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: Under the described Massachusetts syringe advisory, staff refuse a hypodermic-syringe sale solely because the customer has no prescription or ID.

Case B: The customer concludes that permission to buy the syringe also permits purchasing any prescription medicine to put in it without an order.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Providing disposal information creates a statutory maximum package quantity not otherwise stated.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 권고·허용과 확인되지 않은 새 법정 숫자를 구분한다.
교정된 설명: The advisory's appropriate use and disposal information should be distinguished from a new invented quantity cap.

B.original_option_text: Every Schedule V product may be sold OTC in Massachusetts solely because of its schedule.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Product approval·state dispensing rule·별도 경로를 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Federal Schedule V classification alone does not establish that every such product may be sold OTC in Massachusetts.

C.original_option_text: The cited Massachusetts advisory allows the described syringe or needle sale without prescription or ID.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 해당 advisory의 허용 범위를 근거로 판단하며 과거 연령 요약을 복사하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: Permission to buy a syringe authorizes any prescription drug intended for use with it.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 기기와 그 안에 넣는 약의 법적 요구는 다르다.
교정된 설명: Device access does not authorize dispensing the separate prescription medication without its required order.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A veterinarian orders an approved human drug for an animal under an otherwise appropriate extralabel-use pathway.

Case B: The same veterinarian writes an order to treat a human owner's illness, and staff rely on the veterinary license as authority for human treatment.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: An initial telemedicine contact alone necessarily establishes every federal VCPR condition.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 초기 VCPR의 직접 지식 요건과 이후 telemedicine 활용을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: The specified federal VCPR formation conditions differ from merely offering an initial remote consultation.

B.original_option_text: Use of a human drug in an animal is not automatically unlawful when the applicable veterinary conditions are satisfied.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 적법한 veterinarian order·VCPR·AMDUCA 조건을 확인한다.

C.original_option_text: The pharmacist may freely invent an animal dose from a human label without veterinary clarification.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Extralabel 경로가 pharmacist의 임의 animal dose 변경 권한은 아니다.
교정된 설명: An unclear animal dose or species-related direction should be clarified rather than independently guessed.

D.original_option_text: A veterinary license authorizes prescribing to the animal's human owner for the owner's illness.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 치료 대상과 전문직 scope를 구별한다.
교정된 설명: Veterinary scope does not supply authority to treat the owner's human illness.

B.original_option_text: Use of a human drug in an animal is not automatically unlawful when the applicable veterinary conditions are satisfied.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 적법한 veterinarian order·VCPR·AMDUCA 조건을 확인한다.

C.original_option_text: Veterinary scope does not supply authority to treat the owner's human illness.
C.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 치료 대상과 전문직 scope를 구별한다.

D.original_option_text: An initial telemedicine contact alone necessarily establishes every federal VCPR condition.
D.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 초기 VCPR의 직접 지식 요건과 이후 telemedicine 활용을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: The specified federal VCPR formation conditions differ from merely offering an initial remote consultation.

records.original_stem:
Case A: An extralabel drug is dispensed for a food-producing animal without the applicable withdrawal or withholding instructions.

Case B: A Veterinary Feed Directive is treated as an ordinary human Schedule VI prescription with freely renewable extralabel feed use.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Food-residue precautions and required withdrawal or withholding information remain relevant.
A.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Food-producing animal의 public-health residue 보호를 유지한다.

B.original_option_text: AMDUCA automatically authorizes every compound from any bulk active ingredient.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Approved-drug extralabel와 bulk compounding 규제를 구별한다.
교정된 설명: AMDUCA's approved-drug pathway does not itself authorize every bulk-ingredient compound.

C.original_option_text: A patient-name exception permits omitting all animal identification and use directions.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 해당 animal/class/species·dose·route·duration·cautions를 확인한다.
교정된 설명: The extralabel label must identify the relevant animal or class and the required administration directions.

D.original_option_text: A VFD permits unrestricted extralabel feed use under ordinary human Schedule VI refill rules.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. VFD와 일반 patient Rx·human refill을 혼동하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: A VFD is a distinct medicated-feed authorization, and the described extralabel feed use is not permitted.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy performs a rapid test but changes the manufacturer's specimen and timing instructions while assuming its original waived status remains unchanged.

Case B: The pharmacy obtains samples marked not for resale and adds them to ordinary paid prescription inventory.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy may convert not-for-resale samples into routine paid inventory.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Sample의 유통 경로와 일반 stock 매입·재판매를 구분한다.
교정된 설명: Drug samples marked not for resale are not ordinary retail inventory for resale.

B.original_option_text: The word waived eliminates any testing-site certificate or procedure obligation.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Waived가 무규제 검사를 의미하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: A waived-only testing site still needs its applicable certificate and compliance with instructions.

C.original_option_text: A CLIA-waived result grants the pharmacist unrestricted authority to diagnose and prescribe.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Test system·시설 certificate·개인 scope·처방 protocol은 별개이다.
교정된 설명: Obtaining a test result does not independently create diagnostic or prescribing authority.

D.original_option_text: Changing test instructions can affect waived status and requires the appropriate complexity and certificate analysis.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Waived test classification·site certificate·정확한 manufacturer procedure를 구분한다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy uses the current paper Form 222 but combines orders for two suppliers on the same form and relies on obsolete triplicate-copy instructions.

Case B: A supplier partially fulfills an eligible order and proposes starting the 60-day completion period at the first shipment rather than the order date.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Executing the order proves all ordered quantities were physically received that day.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Order·shipment·actual receipt의 기록을 연결한다.
교정된 설명: The purchaser preserves the required executed copy and records actual receipt quantities and dates.

B.original_option_text: The first shipment starts a fresh 60-day completion clock.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Stock order의 order date 후 60일과 patient partial fill 시계는 다르다.
교정된 설명: The stated partial-shipment completion clock runs from the order date.

C.original_option_text: The current described paper system is single-sheet and uses one supplier per form.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Current single-sheet·one-supplier 조건과 과거 양식 설명을 구분한다.

D.original_option_text: An expired registrant may keep ordering because unused forms remain.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 양식 보유와 현재 등록 유효성은 다르다.
교정된 설명: Possession of blank forms does not establish current registration authority.
